message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2)","C_expression":"-1/(sqrt(1+r)*(1+sqrt(1+r)))","derivation":"Retained unchanged from P04_W1 (generation 1) into generation 2. The C-term is set so that dE/du|_{u=0}=0, where E=(2g+g^2-r)+2ug: this requires 2*r*C*(1+g0)+2*g0=0, giving C=-g0/(r*(1+g0))=-1/(s(1+s)). The composite g=(s-1)(s-u)/s then has E=O(u^2*r+r^2) inside chi-support. Both bodies are C-infinity for r>-1, strictly containing the outer rectangle r in [-1/2,1/2]. Numerical confirmation from the generation-1 feedback: in-support UNIFORM points (u~0.008, r~1e-6) show pure~O(u*r)~8e-9 and cross~O(u*r)~-8e-9 with total residual~O(u^2*r)~1e-10, confirming the O(u) cancellation. Out-of-support points (|u|>1/4 or |r|>1/4) correctly receive g=r/2 with no correction. ZERO rows remain exactly 1.0. Neither status affects the numerical answer or eligibility. No full PDE estimates are claimed or implied by retaining this coefficient family."}
